q1_issues.issue: "turned into a gusher" is the named change-of-kind case, which explicitly forbids a spatial "into" oblique ("never a spatial Goal for 'into' here — nothing moves"); the required (Experiencer sk_gusher_1 sk_freedom_movement_1), flat (Member sk_freedom_movement_1 gusher) and (Result sk_turn_1 sk_gusher_1) are all absent.

sk_gusher_1 is minted as a separate entity for what the subject became, which the change-of-kind rule bars outright ("a fresh sk_museum_1 severs the identity") — it should be the reified result STATE predicated of the movement's own symbol.

"as a trickle" is flattened into a copular typing of the movement instead of the preposition-named oblique the PP calls for, and its indefinite NP gets no witness and no class atom — the exactly parallel "a gusher" does get one.

q2_gaps: essive "V as an NP" complement ("started as a trickle"): the instruction set never says whether an essive as-phrase is a preposition-named oblique, a depictive secondary predicate, or a copular predication, and the three give different atoms
figurative / metaphorical predication — nothing addresses a clause whose predicate nominals (trickle, gusher) are metaphors, so the literal reading is asserted as fact
notes: The compound handling is exactly right — freedom_movement fused with its genus and the NOUN modifier correctly left unexposed — and the coordinated VPs are translated independently with the shared subject carried over. The change-of-kind half is the substantive failure: it violates a rule the instruction set states by name and with the same "turned into" wording.
